novelty_flags.label: Theorem 3; related_work; novelty_justification
novelty_flags.one_line: The core calls the published Theorem 3.6 root a product of a reduced unrestricted scheme, but its proof explicitly parameterizes the complete order-three cumulant map and computes the vanishing ideal of that modified map; distinguish any missing realizability restriction precisely instead.
